column1: # The point structures: the object code (the modelField column of the source in the 3D settings) -> the
# model number that the exporter builds on the point (step 3.575). Comment lines start with '#'.
# Models: 1 = a memorial statue (6 variants), 2 = a monument stele (3 variants), 3 = a fountain with
# water running down the post, 4 = a communication tower, 5 = a composter (a waste bin), 6 = a lighting
# mast (polished calcite with glowstone), 7 = a street bench (2x1 oak stairs), 8 = a small sculpture,
# 9 = a bus stop shelter-booth (open on the road side).
